description: From the .18.19 correctness (#6) + minimalism (#4) audits. The coalesce suppresses re-runs of CONCLUDED producers; WAITING producers still get re-enqueued by wait-restart wakes and re-run as no-ops (complete waiting again, changed:[]). Measured: DefineFunction fire counts on 00181 now vary 26-28 run-to-run (per-key e.g. FunctionId(7) [2,3,2], FunctionId(165) [2,3,3]) where the parent was stable — benign (facts converge identically; the fires are waiting no-ops; function/defined fires exactly once every run) but it dilutes the minimal-job-trace signal with schedule-dependent noise. The natural fix is wait-dedup: a job whose standing waits are UNCHANGED since its last waiting completion need not re-run until one of its waited facts actually moves. NOTE: likely subsumed by fz-go4.18.24 (migrating emissions to waits makes the driver own demand entirely) — re-verify scope after .18.24; implement only what remains.
title: Deterministically suppress waiting no-op re-runs (DefineFunction wait-wake races)
